project.name: splanc
project.source: FUG-88 "Draft requirements and risk assessment for Splanc" baseline (UN-1..8, PR-1..25, RISK-1..12), verbatim. The per-risk mitigations FUG-88 states as prose are mitigations MIT-1..12, each implemented by a risk-control requirement PR-26..37 (FUG-89).

user_needs.title: Create, preview and tune effects quickly on desktop and mobile
user_needs.description: Users need to create, preview, and tune effects quickly on desktop and mobile with responsive controls and efficient layouts.

user_needs.title: Understandable, non-blocking, trustworthy AI + remapping workflows
user_needs.description: Users need AI-assisted workflows and control remapping that are understandable, non-blocking, and trustworthy.

user_needs.title: Drive effects from external inputs without extra hardware
user_needs.description: Users need to drive effects from external inputs such as cameras and TouchDesigner without unnecessary hardware dependencies.

user_needs.title: Reliably manage LED topology maps
user_needs.description: Users need to create, reconstruct, import, export, and manage LED topology maps reliably, including larger installations.

user_needs.title: Commission and update devices from the browser
user_needs.description: Users need to commission, name, discover, connect to, and update devices from the browser with minimal setup friction.

user_needs.title: Acceptable quality and predictable performance on device
user_needs.description: Users need acceptable visual quality and predictable runtime performance on constrained device hardware.

user_needs.title: Stability during long sessions and networking/memory pressure
user_needs.description: Users need the device and app to remain stable during long sessions, networking transitions, and memory pressure.

user_needs.title: Fast, reliable, representative automated validation
user_needs.description: Users need automated validation that is fast, reliable, and representative of real device behavior.

requirements.title: Apply display scaling consistently across control types and views
requirements.description: The UI shall apply display scaling consistently across supported control types and views.

requirements.title: Immediate feedback with bounded expensive recompute during drag
requirements.description: The UI shall provide immediate perceptual feedback during continuous adjustments while avoiding excessive expensive recomputation during active drag interactions.

requirements.title: Preserve per-view settings; defaults never override explicit settings
requirements.description: The workspace shall preserve per-view settings and prevent default view modes from overriding explicit user settings.

requirements.title: Efficient use of screen space on desktop and mobile
requirements.description: The workspace shall make efficient use of screen space on desktop and mobile, including 3D previews, panes, menus, and workspace controls.

requirements.title: Informational UI elements never obstruct primary workflows
requirements.description: Informational UI elements such as banners and tooltips shall not obstruct primary workflows and shall be dismissible or self-clearing when appropriate.

requirements.title: AI workflow surfaces render responses and progress clearly
requirements.description: AI workflow surfaces shall render responses clearly, including Markdown where applicable, and shall expose useful progress and completion feedback to the user.

requirements.title: Control remapping to semantic effect inputs without editing source
requirements.description: Control remapping shall let users map hardware controls to semantic effect inputs without rewriting effect source code.

requirements.title: Support local / on-device model workflows where documented
requirements.description: The system shall support local or on-device model workflows where documented capabilities call for them.

requirements.title: Preview effects from camera/video inputs without dedicated hardware
requirements.description: The workspace shall support previewing effects from camera or video-derived inputs even when dedicated hardware is not connected, where feasible.

requirements.title: TouchDesigner texture/uniform-driven effect integration
requirements.description: The system shall support TouchDesigner integration for texture and uniform-driven effect workflows.

requirements.title: Capture, reconstruct, upload, import/export and conflict handling
requirements.description: The mapping workflow shall support capture, reconstruction, upload, import, export, and conflict handling for topology maps.

requirements.title: Tolerate larger installations (batching, scale-aware, recovery)
requirements.description: The mapping workflow shall tolerate larger installations through batching, scale-aware upload behavior, and recovery-oriented handling of reconstruction interruptions.

requirements.title: Browser provisioning, rename, discovery, LAN and direct connection
requirements.description: The browser experience shall support device provisioning, rename, discovery, LAN connection, and direct connection by available connection modes.

requirements.title: Consistent device-visible identity across name/AP/hostname
requirements.description: The system shall derive or maintain device-visible identity consistently across configured name, AP name, hostname, and related discovery surfaces.

requirements.title: Browser firmware update detects hardware and flashes compatible image
requirements.description: The browser-based firmware update flow shall detect hardware appropriately and flash compatible firmware images for the detected target.

requirements.title: Cross-platform browser flashing with safe fallback
requirements.description: The product shall support browser-based flashing across supported client platforms and provide safe fallback behavior where support is limited.

requirements.title: Effect runtime capability + calibrated performance-estimation inputs
requirements.description: The runtime shall support effect execution features needed by the documented effect system, including embedded/runtime type support and calibrated performance estimation inputs.

requirements.title: Performance visibility against device budget
requirements.description: The system shall provide users with performance visibility sufficient to understand whether an effect is likely to run within device budget.

requirements.title: Adapt playback/execution rate to preserve stability
requirements.description: The system shall adapt effect playback rate or execution rate to preserve system stability when performance headroom becomes insufficient.

requirements.title: Visual output calibration (color correction)
requirements.description: The product shall support visual output calibration features such as color correction where documented.

requirements.title: Careful device memory management for networking/control/effects
requirements.description: The device firmware and associated protocols shall manage memory carefully enough to support intended networking, control, and effect workloads on target hardware.

requirements.title: Preserve user work across transient disconnects
requirements.description: The system shall preserve important user work products, such as captures or map data, across transient disconnects whenever practical.

requirements.title: HITL + CI infrastructure validates representative operational flows
requirements.description: HITL and CI infrastructure shall validate provisioning, flashing, connectivity, mapping, and representative operational flows.

requirements.title: Multi-DUT validation isolates test resources safely
requirements.description: The validation system shall support multiple DUTs safely and isolate test resources well enough to prevent cross-device interference.

requirements.title: CI enforces quality gates under routine infrastructure constraints
requirements.description: CI shall enforce quality gates and remain operable under routine infrastructure constraints such as noisy builds, storage pressure, and shared-resource contention.

requirements.title: Bound device allocation pressure and abort unsafe workloads
requirements.description: Reduce allocation pressure, prefer zero-copy or streamed handling where possible, store large static data efficiently, monitor memory budgets, and abort unsafe workloads (mitigates device heap exhaustion/fragmentation).

requirements.title: Calibrate and cover the effect performance model
requirements.description: Expand coverage of modeled operations, calibrate the cost model, validate against held-out workloads, and expose budget visibility so the model does not give false confidence.

requirements.title: Autoscale frame rate and enforce headroom
requirements.description: Autoscale frame rate, enforce headroom targets, and notify or abort when safe operation cannot be maintained, so expensive effects cannot starve the runtime.

requirements.title: Readiness-aware, reconnect-hardened provisioning
requirements.description: Improve readiness checks, investigate coexistence/reconnect behavior, perform repeated provisioning validation, and harden naming/discovery so provisioning/association is reliable.

requirements.title: Isolate per-DUT USB/serial/debug by stable physical identity
requirements.description: Isolate USB/serial/debug resources by stable physical identity while preserving compatibility, so multi-DUT runs never flash/reset/inspect the wrong board.

requirements.title: Recover mapping from large or interrupted captures
requirements.description: Preserve capture data locally, decouple reconstruction from transient device presence, batch uploads, and scale-test the workflow so large or interrupted captures do not lose user work.

requirements.title: Detect flashing capability and provide fallback transports
requirements.description: Detect platform capability, support alternate transport strategies where feasible, and provide clear fallback behavior so browser flashing is usable across client platforms.

requirements.title: Bound preview/thumbnail rendering cost and cache growth
requirements.description: Lazy rendering, bounded cache/TTL policies, and preview performance budgets so media-driven preview and animated thumbnails cannot collapse performance or grow storage unbounded.

requirements.title: Pin the wire schema with cross-language conformance tests
requirements.description: Strengthen schema ownership and compatibility tests, validate payload dimensions/boundaries, and add cross-language conformance tests so binary schema/protocol drift cannot cause catastrophic allocations or corruption.

requirements.title: Reconcile device identity on stable attributes
requirements.description: Reconcile identity on stable hardware attributes where possible, keep naming surfaces consistent, and refresh network-facing identity correctly after changes so IP/hostname/AP/device-record confusion is avoided.

requirements.title: Readiness-aware HITL/CI orchestration with contention control
requirements.description: Replace timing assumptions with readiness-aware orchestration, control shared-resource contention, manage runner storage, and enforce cleaner quality gates so HITL/CI flakiness does not erode trust in results.

requirements.title: UI regression coverage for state, visibility and layout
requirements.description: Regression coverage for settings persistence, visibility, focus, tooltip/banner behavior, and responsive layout so UI state inconsistency or obstruction cannot block primary tasks.

mitigations.title: Bound device allocation pressure and abort unsafe workloads
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-1 (Device heap exhaustion or fragmentation during runtime workloads); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-26.

mitigations.title: Calibrate and cover the effect performance model
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-2 (Effect performance model gives false confidence); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-27.

mitigations.title: Autoscale frame rate and enforce headroom
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-3 (Runtime starvation from expensive effects); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-28.

mitigations.title: Readiness-aware, reconnect-hardened provisioning
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-4 (Provisioning or wireless association is unreliable); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-29.

mitigations.title: Isolate per-DUT USB/serial/debug by stable physical identity
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-5 (Cross-device interference in multi-DUT environments); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-30.

mitigations.title: Recover mapping from large or interrupted captures
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-6 (Mapping reconstruction or upload fails for large/interrupted captures); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-31.

mitigations.title: Detect flashing capability and provide fallback transports
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-7 (Browser flashing unavailable/unreliable on important platforms); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-32.

mitigations.title: Bound preview/thumbnail rendering cost and cache growth
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-8 (Media preview/thumbnail causes perf collapse or cache growth); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-33.

mitigations.title: Pin the wire schema with cross-language conformance tests
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-9 (Binary schema or protocol drift across components); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-34.

mitigations.title: Reconcile device identity on stable attributes
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-10 (Device identity inconsistencies across IP/hostname/AP/records); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-35.

mitigations.title: Readiness-aware HITL/CI orchestration with contention control
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-11 (HITL and CI infrastructure flakiness reduces trust in validation); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-36.

mitigations.title: UI regression coverage for state, visibility and layout
mitigations.description: Risk control for RISK-12 (UI state inconsistency or obstruction blocks primary tasks); FUG-88 prose mitigation, specified as PR-37.

risks.title: Device heap exhaustion or fragmentation during runtime workloads
risks.description: Undermines UN-5, UN-6, UN-7 by causing disconnects, instability, or inability to complete operations during networking/control workloads.
risks.residual: Reduced but not eliminated — long-session heap headroom still needs on-hardware soak coverage (PR-26 is HITL-demanded).

risks.title: Effect performance model gives false confidence
risks.description: The model allows effects that exceed realistic runtime budget, undermining UN-6 and indirectly threatening UN-7.
risks.residual: Bounded by held-out validation, but the cost model only tracks reality as well as its device calibration (PR-27 is HIL-demanded).

risks.title: Runtime starvation from expensive effects
risks.description: Expensive effects cause unstable frame rate or harm other firmware responsibilities, undermining UN-6 and UN-7.

risks.title: Provisioning or wireless association is unreliable
risks.description: Directly harms UN-5 and weakens UN-8 when HITL depends on it.
risks.residual: Reconnect/coexistence hardening helps, but association reliability is only as good as the last repeated on-bench provisioning run (PR-29 is HITL).

risks.title: Cross-device interference in multi-DUT environments
risks.description: The wrong board is flashed, reset, or inspected, harming UN-8 and invalidating automation confidence.

risks.title: Mapping reconstruction or upload fails for large/interrupted captures
risks.description: Harms UN-4 and UN-7 by risking loss of user work or inability to complete installations.

risks.title: Browser flashing unavailable/unreliable on important platforms
Media preview/thumbnail causes perf collapse or cache growth
risks.description: Harms UN-1, UN-3, UN-6 through performance collapse or unbounded cache/storage growth.

risks.title: Binary schema or protocol drift across components
risks.description: Causes catastrophic allocations or corrupted behavior, harming UN-3, UN-4, UN-6, UN-7.
risks.residual: Cross-language conformance tests catch drift at simulation level; the residual is schema changes shipped without regenerating a consumer.

risks.title: HITL and CI infrastructure flakiness reduces trust in validation
risks.description: Harms UN-8 through unreliable validation results.

risks.title: UI state inconsistency or obstruction blocks primary tasks
risks.description: Confuses users and blocks primary tasks, harming UN-1 and UN-2.
